mia_pm: Quick decision needed: do we default Private installs to a conservative safety-profile for upgrades? Field requests prefer fewer surprises.
oliver_eng: I support conservative by default. Behavior: require manual approval for major migrations, auto-canary only for minor patches, always snapshot KV before changes.
hana_netops: From networking, conservative means we do NOT reassign egress IPs during node rotations unless customer opts in. Must document static-egress steps.
sam_ops: Ops ask: include a dry-run flag that simulates hooks and smoke tests without applying changes. Also surface percent-complete and current cohort in CLI output.
anya_support: Support needs the diag bundle auto-collected before/after upgrade and a short runbook to triage common failures. Send bundle to support S3 if customer consents.
omer_eng: minor note: airgapped customers need an offline package verifier (local signature check). We'll add a --verify-local option.
mia_pm: Good. Launch checklist for conservative default: installer with --maintenance and --dry-run, snapshot+revert tooling, offline verifier for airgap, network quickstart for static-egress, diag bundle + runbook, and 2-field pilots.
oliver_eng: I'll PR the manifest schema for pre/post hooks with a dry-run option. Also add semver rules for package vs model bundles.
sam_ops: I'll prototype the percent-complete progress and snapshot CLI this sprint.
hana_netops: I'll draft the firewall templates and static-egress preserve steps.
anya_support: I'll prepare triage playbook and consent flow for diag bundle upload.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: private-conservative-alpha to staging at 2024-07-08T16:00:00Z.
mia_pm: Thanks team 10m checkpoint Thursday. Ping if any blocker on the PR or prototype.
